entities.summary: Nathaniel Perry Solder is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Colorado Buffaloes, and was recognized as a consensus All-American. Solder was selected by the New England Patriots in the first round of the 2011 NFL draft and won two Super Bowls as a member of the team.
